points.sentence: Once you get 100+ views per month, then reconnect your Pinterest account with Blotato and it will be automatically verified.

points.point: Needs to post this week (any faster way)
points.sentence: Blotato no longer verifies Pinterest accounts manually. There is no request to send. Verification happens automatically once you reconnect with 100+ monthly views. There is no manual override -- the 100 monthly views threshold is the only unlock criterion.

verdict.reason: This entry explains that verification happens automatically at 100+ monthly views and that there is no manual override, which answers both the 'why' and the need to post this week.
